report_name: SafePal Data Breach Exposes Nearly 40,000 Hardware Wallet Customers

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Threat Actor
threat_actors.description: An unauthorized external party that exploited a BOLA/IDOR vulnerability in a third-party plugin on SafePal's e-commerce site to scrape customer data and offer it for sale on a cybercrime forum.
threat_actors.goals: Monetize stolen customer PII by selling it on a cybercrime forum.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The attacker exploited a Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR) vulnerability in a third-party order-tracking plugin on SafePal's public-facing e-commerce website to gain unauthorized access to customer data.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: The stolen personal information, including names and email addresses, is being used to conduct follow-on spearphishing campaigns against affected SafePal customers, as reported by at least one victim.

attack_patterns.name: Email Addresses
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor gathered 39,798 customer email addresses as part of the data exfiltration to enable future phishing and social engineering attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Web Services
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor utilized a cybercrime forum, a type of web service, to advertise and sell the stolen SafePal customer data.

vulnerabilities.name: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
vulnerabilities.description: A Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA), also known as an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR), vulnerability in a third-party order-tracking plugin on SafePal's e-commerce site allowed an attacker to systematically access and exfiltrate other customers' order information by manipulating an identifier in an API request.

identities.name: SafePal
identities.description: A cryptocurrency hardware wallet provider whose e-commerce site was breached, exposing the personal data of 39,798 customers.

identities.name: SafePal Customers
identities.description: A group of 39,798 customers of the SafePal hardware wallet whose personal information (name, email, phone, shipping address) was exposed in the data breach.

infrastructure.name: Cybercrime Forum
infrastructure.description: A web forum used by the threat actor to advertise and sell the dataset of 39,798 stolen SafePal customer records.

indicators.name: SafePal Phishing Typosquatting Domain

id: 7c5d8a3e-1b9f-4e2a-8d6c-9f8b7a6d5c4b
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries for a typosquatted domain related to SafePal, likely used in phishing campaigns targeting wallet users.
references:

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:

  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'safepal-support.io'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects DNS queries for a typosquatted domain related to SafePal, likely used in phishing campaigns targeting wallet users.
